events.title: Beauty & the Bass
events.description:
Beauty & The Bass fuses fashion & EDM for one explosive Detroit night. Bold looks, heavy bass, nonstop energy. One unforgettable experience.

BEAUTY X THE BASS — Detroit’s Runway‑Meets‑Rave Experience
Beauty X The Bass is bringing three creative worlds together for one unforgettable night in Detroit. This event blends the edge of fashion with the pulse of Dubstep, Drum And Bass music, and Flow Arts creating an atmosphere where style, sound, and self expression collide.

Expect bold looks, innovative designers, high energy performances, and a lineup of DJs and artists who know how to move a crowd. This night isn’t just about watching a show, it’s about stepping into a space built for people who thrive on creativity and aren’t afraid to stand out.

BEAUTY X THE BASS
November 13, 2026
8:00 PM TO 3:00 AM
Detroit, MI

Whether you’re walking the runway, behind the decks, showcasing your designs, sharing flow arts, or just coming to experience something different, Beauty X The Bass is building a night where creativity has no limits.

Dress to make an impact.
Come ready for the The ARTS.
Four Worlds. One night. One Price A Detroit experience you won’t forget.
